about.journeyText: We understand the student journey, because we have experienced this process too...
about.companyDescription:
Aparthouse.com.tr helps with international or local student housing. Since its establishment in 2024, we have been helping thousands of students find their homes with our experienced team.

We have the widest and carefully selected range of apartments specially built and managed for students. This allows you to explore and compare various apartments near different universities, so you can make the right choice.
